title: An exploratory study of workplace occupational safety and health interventions and their impact on productivity and performance in an ageing workforce
core_idea: An exploratory, questionnaire-based study grounded in the literature that maps common occupational safety and health (OSH) interventions in the context of an ageing workforce and investigates the key drivers and barriers that shape their impact on OSH performance and productivity.
tldr: Map OSH interventions for an ageing workforce and assess which contextual drivers and barriers influence their effects on workplace safety performance and productivity using an exploratory questionnaire study.
